notes: Supply tab redesigned for fast manual use: paste a location from the game, Enter moves between fields, Ctrl+Enter starts, quick package presets and a package manager, live stock coverage per resource, and a Status column that says why each bank is or is not used. A supply order no longer stops with 'customer is no longer in the guild' while the customer is still there: banks now ask the game for a fresh guild list and read it twice before ending an order. The cart flag no longer marks a bank ineligible; the Carts column shows free march slots. Only castle 17 and above can be sent as a Leader.
